entities.summary: Robert Thomas Joyce is a former Canadian ice hockey player who played six seasons in the National Hockey League (NHL) for the Boston Bruins, Washington Capitals and Winnipeg Jets between 1988 and 1993. He was drafted by the Bruins in the fourth round in the 1984 NHL Entry Draft from the University of North Dakota.
